modes.name: attributes
modes.description: Custom attributes — `attributes: [A, …]` names the attributes the filter compares, stored on the `attributes` list, which the widget's editorConfig shows only when attrChoice is "linked" (Custom). The builder's SetAttributeObjects writes "linked" whenever it fills the list; the mode states it so check reads the configuration exec stores (ako/mxcli#1684 — the constant "auto" made MDL-WIDGET10 call the list hidden). Same shape as the drop-down filter's `attribute` mode (mendixlabs/mxcli#1519).

modes.name: default
modes.description: Auto — no attributes given: the filter takes the attribute of the Data grid 2 column it sits in (attrChoice "auto"), so it only works inside a column.
